process_map_inventory.summary: User opens customer management. Required customer or account details are entered or updated. System validates mandatory information and business rules. Master data is saved and made available to downstream workflows.

User opens daily processing. Required workflow data is captured. System validates the business rules for the transaction or request. The resulting business state is saved and available for downstream use.

User opens date range processing. Required workflow data is captured. System validates the business rules for the transaction or request. The resulting business state is saved and available for downstream use.

User opens deposit capture. Required workflow data is captured. System validates the business rules for the transaction or request. The resulting business state is saved and available for downstream use.

User opens the authentication workflow. User enters credentials and submits the request. System validates access rules and either rejects or authorizes the request. Authorized users proceed to the operational navigation hub.
User opens splash/loading. System performs startup and readiness checks. Progress or readiness feedback is shown. Operational workflow becomes available when startup gating completes.

User opens withdrawal processing. Required workflow data is captured. System validates the business rules for the transaction or request. The resulting business state is saved and available for downstream use.
